records.failureSummary:
Backend deliverable for T5 is complete and in place in src/render.mjs; no further backend-only change can move the task's test gate, which is blocked by an unsatisfiable assertion in a QA-authored test. Verified in this run: npm run build exit 0, npm run lint exit 0, npm run test = 89 tests, 72 pass, 16 skipped, 1 fail, 0 errors. renderTable assembles the header row, separator row and data rows in order and joins them with a single ' ' (no trailing newline, no blank lines); when table.rows is empty only the header row and the separator row are emitted. Cells are normalized through toInlineCell (newline ->
, | -> \|, trim), column widths come from computeColumnWidths (max(3, converted length incl. header)), and every column including the last is right-padded. Separator markers are left=:---, right=---:, center=:--:, none=--- with --- fallback when align is missing/non-array/out-of-range/unknown. Trust-boundary inputs are handled defensively (null table/options, non-array headers/rows/align, short or non-array data rows treated as empty cells). src/parse.mjs is untouched and the existing exports/API contract are preserved; buildSeparatorRow is additive only. All AC-01 (row structure, ' ' join, no trailing newline) and AC-06 (empty rows -> exactly two lines) renderTable tests pass, as do AC-02..AC-05, AC-08 and AC-09. The single remaining failure is line 73/79 of test/renderTable.cellsAndSeparator.ac02ac05.test.mjs: input { headers: [" a"], rows: [[" | "]] } is a single-column table, but computeColumnWidths is asserted to deepEqual [4,3]. At the same time the frozen T1 contract in test/computeColumnWidths.test.mjs asserts widths.length === headers.length, and col0's converted header "
a" has 5 characters, so the correct value is [5]. No conformant renderTable or computeColumnWidths can return [4,3] for that input; the defect is a test-side expectation, and fixing it is outside the backend-only change scope of this task. The two ACs owned by this task (AC-01, AC-06) and the instruction to not modify src/parse.mjs are satisfied.
